question: India's Jhulan Goswami was in the news on 16 March 2022 for becoming the highest wicket taker in Women's ODIs by claiming 250 wickets. Against which team did she achieve this fear?
solution:
The correct answer is __**England**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jhulan Goswami, an Indian cricketer, is one of the most successful bowlers in women's cricket history.
 
• On 16 March 2022, she became the highest wicket-taker in Women's ODIs by claiming her 250th wicket.
 
• She achieved this milestone during a match against England.
 
• Jhulan Goswami is celebrated for her significant contributions to Indian women's cricket, particularly as a bowler.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jhulan Goswami**

 
 
• She made her debut in international cricket in 2002 and has since been a pivotal player for the Indian women's cricket team.
 
• She is known for her pace and accuracy, making her one of the most feared bowlers in women's cricket.
 
• In addition to her ODI success, she has also made notable contributions in Test and T20I formats.
 
• Jhulan has been awarded several honors, including the ICC Women's Player of the Year in 2007.
 
 
 
• **Women's One Day International (ODI) Cricket**
 
 
• ODI cricket is a format of limited overs cricket, played between two teams with international status.
 
• Each team faces a fixed number of overs, usually 50.
 
• Women's ODI cricket has gained significant popularity and recognition over the years, with many countries actively participating in international tournaments.
 
• The ICC Women's Cricket World Cup is the premier international championship of women's ODI cricket.
 
 
 
• **Wicket-taking in Cricket**
 
 
• In cricket, taking a wicket refers to the dismissal of a batsman by the bowler or the fielding team.
 
• Dismissals can occur in several ways, including being bowled, caught, leg before wicket (LBW), run out, and stumped.
 
• Wicket-taking is a crucial aspect of the game, as it helps to restrict the opposing team's score and bring about their batting collapse.
 
• Successful bowlers like Jhulan Goswami play a key role in their team's success by consistently taking wickets.
